terms.comment: Classically any hollow, a trough or a channel.

phrases.latin: Rīvus, quī vēre strepit, siccus erat, alveusque nūdīs lapidibus strātus.
phrases.english: The stream, which babbles in spring, was dry, and its bed was covered in bare stones.

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 206, checked against the searchable text of the book on 29 October 2026.

Theodōrus et pater · Ad Larem avītum, Libellī I–VII, as they stood on 7 November 2026, with their glosses. Examples marked “Libellus” quote those texts word for word; classical passages are cited by author.
